chain_words.nuance: to place something over an object so it is no longer visible
to partly obscure something, often with a thin layer
to keep something hidden deliberately, often from a particular person
to hide the true nature or feelings behind an outward appearance
to change one's appearance completely so as not to be recognised

explanation: These words all describe keeping something out of sight, from simply covering it to changing its appearance so it cannot be recognised.

usage_notes.difference: 'Conceal' means keeping something hidden; 'disguise' means changing the appearance of something or someone so that it is not recognised.
